job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Full-Stack Developer to join our team at Digital Apple. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both front-end and back-end development, with a strong passion for delivering high-quality software solutions.



Roles and Responsibility




Design, develop, and test full-stack applications using various programming languages and technologies.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.


Develop and maintain large-scale web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other relevant technologies.


Ensure the quality and performance of developed applications by testing and debugging them.


Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.


Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance skills and knowledge.




Job Requirements




Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, etc.


Experience with front-end development frameworks like React, Angular, Vue.js, etc.


Knowledge of back-end development frameworks like Node.js, Django, Ruby on Rails, etc.


Strong understanding of database concepts and experience with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.


Familiarity with version control systems like Git.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.




Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
